title: Efficiency: inbuf_append is O(n^2) in write call count
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c inbuf_append() — every write() to an UNSET fd (key import path) allocates a new buffer of size old_len + new_len, copies all accumulated data, then frees the old buffer. For a caller that writes an ML-DSA-87 key (4896 bytes) in small chunks, total byte-copy work is O(total_key_size * num_writes / 2). Worst case: 8192 writes of 1 byte each yields ~33M byte-copies plus 8192 GFP_KERNEL allocations. Production concern at any scale where large PQ keys are written in sub-page chunks. Fix: pre-allocate inbuf at CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN on first write to UNSET fd, then copy directly into the fixed buffer.
